nodes.label: AppRegistry
nodes.desc: Registers the root component with runApplication and hands rendering to the configured renderer.

nodes.label: ReactFabric (dev)
nodes.desc: Generated Fabric reconciler build for RN; the JS half of the new architecture.

nodes.label: TurboModuleRegistry
nodes.desc: Typed lazy lookup of native modules; get() returns null on miss, getEnforcing() throws.

nodes.label: NativeModules shim
nodes.desc: Compatibility layer that keeps old bridge-style native module access working on top of the new runtime.

nodes.label: MessageQueue
nodes.desc: Legacy batching queue: __guard() serializes calls and __callFunction() dispatches into JS modules.

nodes.label: jsi::Runtime
nodes.desc: Abstract C++ interface implemented by Hermes and JSC; the seam the whole C++ layer is written against.

nodes.label: jsi::HostObject
nodes.desc: Native object visible to JS; every property read funnels through its get() method.

nodes.label: jsi::Value
nodes.desc: Move-only handle for any JS value, kept alive by the runtime's scope rules.

nodes.label: NativeToJsBridge
nodes.desc: Async native-to-JS bridge retained for backwards compatibility; loadBundle() feeds the bundle in.

nodes.label: ModuleRegistry
nodes.desc: Registry of old-style native modules addressed by index in the batched protocol.

nodes.label: JSExecutor
nodes.desc: Abstraction over how application JS gets executed inside the legacy bridge.

nodes.label: CallInvoker
nodes.desc: Schedules work onto the JS thread either synchronously or asynchronously, keeping native threads safe.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.desc: Owns the ShadowTreeRegistry and delegates mounting output to the mounting manager.

nodes.label: UIManager
nodes.desc: C++ UIManager acting as ShadowTreeDelegate: resolves component descriptors and dispatches commands.

nodes.label: UIManagerBinding
nodes.desc: HostObject wrapper exposing the UIManager to JS so the reconciler can commit from the JS thread.

nodes.label: ShadowNode
nodes.desc: Immutable shadow element carrying props, state, and children; extends jsi::NativeState.

nodes.label: ComponentDescriptor
nodes.desc: Per-component factory: createShadowNode() builds nodes and cloneShadowNode() copies them for edits.

nodes.label: EventDispatcher
nodes.desc: Routes user events from native views to the JS handlers attached to shadow nodes.

nodes.label: ShadowTree
nodes.desc: Commit machinery: tryCommit() races against other threads and commit() retries until it wins.

nodes.label: MountingCoordinator
nodes.desc: Pairs consecutive revisions into minimal diff transactions for the platform to apply.

nodes.label: TelemetryController
nodes.desc: Records per-commit timing data so mounting cost can be measured and tuned.

nodes.label: TurboModule
nodes.desc: HostObject-based native module; MethodMetadata maps JS method names to C++ entries.

nodes.label: TurboModuleBinding
nodes.desc: install() binds __turboModuleProxy into the runtime; get() instantiates modules on first access.

nodes.label: CxxTurboModuleUtils
nodes.desc: Helpers for registering pure C++ TurboModules without platform-specific glue.

nodes.label: LongLivedObjectCollection
nodes.desc: Keeps promises and callbacks alive across async native work so they can resolve later.

nodes.label: Bridging umbrella
nodes.desc: One header pulling in typed converters (Bool, Number, AString, Promise...) for C++/JS data exchange.

nodes.label: generateSpecFromInMemorySchema
nodes.desc: Codegen that turns typed JS specs into native interface files, keeping both sides in lockstep.

nodes.label: ReactNativeFeatureFlags
nodes.desc: About 97 static feature flags gating renderer and runtime behavior per rollout stage.

nodes.label: calculateLayout()
nodes.desc: Recursive flexbox solver with caching; the single measurement engine behind every node.

nodes.label: YGNode
nodes.desc: Yoga's layout node: style, resolved dimensions, and cached measurement results.
